ambition.why: Closes a whole class (a hung provider freezes a job and its screen) with one core rather than five patches; the cost is that fetch already has a runtime default, so the hang is rarer than the card implies.

grounding.why: Every cited line says what the card says, the 22-stub and wrapper consumers are listed, and the core-enforces-the-deadline design survives the wrappers that drop the signal.

falsifiability.why: Never-settling stubs raced against a 1 s sentinel fail a stub implementation, and case 17 (re-ask hang returns the first shape error after exactly 2 calls) pins the subtle path.

cards.deck_line: Approve: no engine call can hang a job forever, and every provider failure arrives as a typed EngineError with the desk's own reason sentence.

PenConversation.kt:93-111 later Hello is Deliver and ignored by PenEngine - true
PLATFORM-RISK.md:59, :82 - true

ambition.why: Finds a real protocol bug (the TV is deaf for 10 s of every 15 on the relay) and fixes it in the sans-IO core with JVM cases; relay is the portability hedge, not the shipped default.

grounding.why: The whole causal chain from 5 s watchdog to backoff arithmetic to the silent drop checks out line by line.

falsifiability.why: Cases 1-6 are deterministic JUnit; case 7 is a device journey, and no case bounds PIN guessing on the shared path.

cards.revise: Add case 5b and a rollback line: on a shared conversation, N (say 5) wrong-PIN hellos in a row make further hellos, right PIN included, refused with no Deliver until a cooldown tick; the dropped Close otherwise lets a 4-digit PIN (Session.kt pin 1000..9999) be guessed without friction over the relay, and note that case 5's Unpaired(pen-a) on a stranger's wrong PIN needs the same cooldown to avoid kicking the current drawer.
cards.deck_line: Approve after the revise: the TV stays dialled and a late or second phone pairs over the relay, with a guess limit replacing the wrong-PIN hang-up.
